Structural opportunities

No forecast required

Stakes recompute client-side from each bet's screened probability, market probability, and book disagreement (σ) using the same uncertainty-shrunk fractional-Kelly formula as the CLI (pricing/kelly.py), then a single pass of the same per-bet / per-game / per-book / total-exposure caps the portfolio optimizer applies (pricing/portfolio.py). It is not the full correlation-aware optimizer — that runs only in the CLI — so treat these totals as a close approximation, not the exact figure a live run would produce.

Filtering and sorting act on the bets already screened into this card. They do not re-run the EV screen itself — to change what qualifies for a card in the first place, adjust filters.* in the config and rerun sharp-edge card.
